Watered early just because I learned that he should get a proper soak when watered
Top up when water visibly decreases. Fully change if water gets murky. Rooting will take at least 4 weeks.

When you do pot her up: Start with a pot just slightly bigger than the root mass, not huge Use a well-draining but moisture-retentive mix — Forbidden Cereal should work, maybe with extra sphagnum since water roots are used to constant hydration Keep soil consistently moist (not soggy) for the first 2-3 weeks while she transitions Humidity helps a lot during the transition — if she'll be in a dry spot, maybe bag her loosely with a clear plastic bag for the first week to create a mini greenhouse No fertilizer for at least a month after potting — classic "let her establish first" rule
I think he looks better today!

Do NOT water again until the top 2+ inches are dry AND the condensation in the bottom is gone. Could be a week, could be longer. Let her actually dry out this time. And next time she does the wilt… make her prove it. Finger in the dirt first. She's the girl who cried thirsty.
No big changes. Slight decrease in water level.
